title: Free-Reduction Allowance Base on Blocks Carrying Increases (Group Room Blocks)
content:
**Ruling.** On Group Room Blocks, the room nights a reduction addendum's free-reduction allowance is measured on follow the block's increases:

- when the block carries increase entries on its ledger and the latest of them is dated **no more than 90 calendar days** after the contract was signed, they are the room nights contracted at signing plus all the room nights of those increase entries;
- when the latest increase entry is dated **later than 90 calendar days** after signing, they are the room nights contracted at signing plus **0.5** (one half) of the room nights of the increase entries;
- when the block carries no increase entry, they are the room nights contracted at signing alone.

The room nights contracted at signing are the room nights of the block's allocation entry; the contract signing date is the one shown on the block record.

### Worked bases (hypothetical block: allocation entry 200 room nights, increase entries totalling 40 room nights)

| Latest increase entry dated, after signing | Room nights the allowance is measured on |
|---|---|
| 60 days | 200 plus 40, that is 240 |
| 90 days | 200 plus 40, that is 240 |
| 91 days | 200 plus one half of 40, that is 220 |
| no increase entry | 200 |

With increase entries totalling 25 room nights and the latest dated 120 days after signing, the base is 200 plus 12.5, that is 212.5 room nights.
